# pico-otel

> OpenTelemetry auto-instrumentation for the Pico ecosystem: tracing, metrics and log correlation wired by entry points.

Install: `pip install pico-otel`. Import surface: `from pico_otel import ...`.

## Public API

- `class OtelSettings` — ``traces_exporter``: ``auto`` (otlp if ``endpoint`` set, else console),
- `class OtelBootstrap` — Idempotent SDK setup + auto-instrumentation of installed libraries.
- `class OtelFastApiConfigurer` — Instruments the FastAPI app; collected structurally by pico-fastapi
